subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers adopt the open fork PR for this Google Chat `NO_REPLY` placeholder cleanup, or close it and queue a replacement fix in the target repository?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but an open fork PR already claims the same fix and automation should not create a competing PR until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Refresh or port the open fork PR if maintainers want that contribution to remain the implementation path, then require current-main tests and real Google Chat proof.

options.title: Close candidate and replace
options.body: Close the fork candidate as non-viable and queue one narrow replacement fix in the target repository while preserving contributor credit where appropriate.

options.title: Leave waiting
options.body: Keep this issue open without new repair work only if maintainers expect the fork author to return with proof or updates soon.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Refresh or port the open fork PR if maintainers want that contribution to remain the implementation path, then require current-main tests and real Google Chat proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the Google Chat reply-delivery lifecycle, where recent history shows the strongest owner signal.
